snippet.title: Farmers 2050
snippet.description:
Droughts occur, mortgage payments come due, and farm chores never stop. Discover what it really takes to feed the world.

Create and manage a sustainable farm of your own, using the new Farmers 2050 app. Plant crops, raise animals and craft goods to sell in your local community, while managing the three pillars of sustainability: environmental, economic and social. Get help from local experts, such as agronomists, veterinarians or mechanics – and customize and decorate your farm to make it one of a kind. Along the way, real farmers from around the world will show you what they are doing on their farms.

Are you up for the challenge of feeding 9 billion people by the year 2050?

Farmers is FREE to play. No advertisements or in-app purchases. 
www.Farmers2050.com
